summary: Nix research program phase 7: opus drafters write the depth files of the nix-quality rule from the consolidations, pipelined into the index drafter; skills and the ocx ADR draft alongside
logs: Done: 1/1 indexes · 15 IDs dropped at authoring · 0 files still unclean

hoist_to_index: NIX-FLK-16: git add every file a git-backed flake reads before any nix eval, build or flake check (git ls-files --others --exclude-standard . empty = pass)
NIX-FLK-07: never read a file at evaluation time through the flake's own source store path ("${src}/Cargo.lock"); read ./Cargo.lock, red only on a cold store
NIX-FLK-08/09: iterate systems with nixpkgs.lib.genAttrs over a literal list, no flake-utils, flakeExposed or nix-systems/default, and no x86_64-darwin on nixpkgs 26.11 or unstable
depth.routing_row: writing or restructuring flake.nix outputs, iterating systems, instantiating nixpkgs, adding packages, overlays, apps, devShells, formatter, checks or templates

hoist_to_index: NIX-INP-04: a published flake's committed flake.lock holds no absolute path:, git+file: or cross-tree relative path: input (outside Authoring notes item 4's list, so the index owner decides)

NIX-INP-07: move a lock entry with nix flake update <input>, never nix flake lock (stale path: narHash) and never --update-input or --recreate-lock-file (outside item 4's list, so the index owner decides)
depth.routing_row: adding, removing or retargeting an input, writing follows, bumping or reviewing flake.lock, using submodules, LFS or sub-flakes

rule_ids_dropped: NIX-PKG-20: retired per Authoring notes item 6 (a CONSIDER cost fact with no red/green pair and no diff it changes). The file names it in a 'retired, not reused' line, and its 7m12s cost goes under NIX-GATE-10 in gates.md.
NIX-PKG-01 (sentence only): the builtin-fetcher half was cut and now cites NIX-INP-10 (E19).
NIX-PKG-08 (sentence only): the unscoped 'in CI' became 'each named current package's meta.license' and cites NIX-REL-11 (E14).
NIX-PKG-07 (clause only): homepage moved out of the MUST presence set to SHOULD. D license goes to NIX-GEN-14 and D description/homepage to NIX-GEN-21 (E36, E15).

NIX-PKG-21 (correction, not a drop): the consolidation's overlay 'final: prev:' fails deadnix with 'Unused lambda argument: final' (watched 2026-09-27). The file ships '_final: prev:', which passes deadnix and was re-evaluated green.

NIX-PKG-19 (correction): the consolidation's clap heuristic grep -e 'command(version' missed #[command(author, version, about)] (watched). It was reworded to -e '#\[command(.*version' -e '#\[clap(.*version' -e '\.version('.

NIX-PKG-04 (addition): '--rebuild' alone on a path that was never built exits 1 with 'not valid, so checking is not possible' (watched). The gate is now a plain build followed by '--rebuild', and failure mode 15 records the trap.
hoist_to_index: NIX-PKG-04 (with NIX-PKG-03): never hand-write a hash; every fetcher edit resets hash to lib.fakeHash and is verified by nix build then nix build --rebuild .#default.src, never a plain build alone
NIX-PKG-05: src is lib.fileset.toSource over an explicit list, never ./. or self; the drvPath must not move on a README-only edit
NIX-PKG-15 (with NIX-FLK-07): cargoLock.lockFile = ./Cargo.lock, never "${src}/Cargo.lock" or builtins.path { path = self; }; proven by nix flake check --no-build on a fresh git archive tarball
depth.routing_row: writing or editing a derivation or `package.nix`: fetchers and hashes, `src` filtering, `meta`, phases, version checks, Rust or Python builders

hoist_to_index: NIX-GEN-12: every prebuilt package, in any shape, sets meta.sourceProvenance = [ lib.sourceTypes.binaryNativeCode ] unconditionally
NIX-GEN-01: a generated flake commits its data file and reads it with builtins.fromJSON (builtins.readFile ./data.json), never fetching registry or index data during evaluation
NIX-GEN-15: gate every generated-data update on a sandboxed smoke run of each changed binary (plus --rebuild of changed fetches on a warm store), never on nix flake check --no-build alone
depth.routing_row: packaging a binary you did not build, or generating packages from an external index (committed data, reader, updater)

rule_ids_dropped: NIX-PKG-20: not a GATE ID. It is retired into the cost note under NIX-GATE-10 (authoring notes item 6), and the note's text marks it as retired
fleet 'MUST declare formatter' clause of NIX-GATE-01: moved to the nix-flake-adopt skill under E3, and not a portable rule
[gate] Verdict 5 'checker limit' reading of `-source is not valid`: withdrawn by E11. The GATE-09 triage row now reads as an author defect (NIX-FLK-07, NIX-PKG-15)
hoist_to_index: NIX-GATE-10: build every package the flake defines, not only .#default. A green nix flake check is not a build (E27 changes gate step 6 to the eval-and-xargs pipeline)
NIX-GATE-08: ban IFD with --option allow-import-from-derivation false, because --no-build alone passes on a warm store

NIX-GATE-05: deadnix needs both --fail and --no-lambda-pattern-names. Without --fail it exits 0 on findings. Item 4 says these three belong in the index as gate-block lines, not in the non-negotiables list
depth.routing_row: running or wiring the gate: formatter, deadnix, statix, `nix flake check`, the CI workflow, installer, cache, implementation legs

hoist_to_index: NIX-REL-01: read `version` from the manifest through a source-tree path (`lib.importTOML ./Cargo.toml`), never a literal, never via `${src}`
NIX-REL-02: emit the manifest version verbatim, with no rev/date/-dirty/-unstable suffix, so that the version at tag vX.Y.Z is exactly X.Y.Z
NIX-REL-11: never put `abort-on-warn` on `nix flake check` or a whole-flake build. Apply it only to named current attributes or a shim-free `packages.<system>` set
depth.routing_row: choosing a version string, tagging or publishing, deprecating an output, writing install instructions, supporting non-flake users, running nix-update, preparing a nixpkgs copy

rule_ids_dropped: NIX-LANG-09: retired per Authoring notes item 6. The localization order is a procedure and becomes steps in the nix-diagnose skill. The file names it once on a retirement line, and the number is not reused.
hoist_to_index: NIX-LANG-02: reach a file or derivation output at build time only through interpolation or lib.fileset.toSource, never toString or unsafeDiscardStringContext (eval-time reads are NIX-FLK-07)
NIX-LANG-04: no builtins.getEnv, nixPath, currentSystem or <nixpkgs> reachable from outputs, because getEnv returns "" and nixPath [ ] with exit 0 under pure eval
NIX-LANG-10: classify an 'infinite recursion encountered' by shape with --show-trace before changing anything, never a generic fix (drop a system, drop the overlay, rename final: to self:)
depth.routing_row: writing Nix expressions (rec, let, with, //, paths and string context, impure builtins) or reading an evaluation error

rule_ids_dropped: none: all nine NIX-SEC IDs named in Authoring notes item 2 ship. The consolidation's two non-ID drops stay dropped: FOD __impureEnvVars (NIX-PKG and NIX-GEN own it) and nixConfig.warn-dirty as its own rule (folded into the NIX-SEC-01 finding keys)
hoist_to_index: NIX-SEC-02: never set, pass, script or recommend accept-flake-config, in any file, and never answer Nix's trust prompt with 'permanently'
NIX-SEC-04: never let a secret reach evaluation. No tracked secret file, no readFile or getEnv of a secret, no credential in a derivation attribute, because the store is world-readable at mode 444
NIX-SEC-05: evaluate a flake you do not own only at a full 40-hex rev with --no-write-lock-file --option allow-import-from-derivation false, and never nix develop, shell, run or direnv allow it
depth.routing_row: touching nixConfig, tokens, secrets, substituters or trusted keys, the Nix version CI runs, or evaluating a flake you do not own

depth.routing_row: writing a NixOS, home-manager, nix-darwin or flake-parts module a flake exports, or the check that evaluates one
